FIELD GUIDE

About this collection

The original images and filenames are preserved from the course folder. Some source files have limited resolution: zooming enlarges pixels, not geological detail.

Modern additions have separate mission credits and source links. Image scales and processing differ; do not compare crater counts or brightness directly without checking area, resolution, and illumination.

The original PDF includes the pre-lab and Activity 1 calculations. Its historical planetary-data table has not been revised.

ASTRONOMY 101 Make observations first. Support interpretations with visible evidence.
